title: The category of coherent formal modules is abelian
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals. Then the category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] is abelian; the cokernel of a morphism $\alpha=(\alpha_n):(\mathcal F_n)\to(\mathcal G_n)$ is the inverse system $(\operatorname{Coker}\alpha_n)_n$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), part (1), and the description of cokernels in its proof
